title: Ankhorage MCP
summary: Secure provider-neutral Model Context Protocol runtime and Ankh CLI provider.
purpose: Discover provider integrations, register their tools, enforce declared account and approval boundaries, and expose them through a standard MCP transport.
domain: Model Context Protocol hosting and tool governance
responsibilities: Discover published MCP integrations from configured providers.
Validate and register provider tools with their declared risk, scope, and account identity.
Enforce approval and account-scope policy before tool execution.
Expose registered tools through a standard-input/output MCP server and Ankh CLI capabilities.
boundaries: Does not implement provider-specific business integrations.
Does not infer authorization beyond the scope and approval facts supplied at the boundary.
Does not own provider credentials or account persistence.
audience: Applications hosting MCP tools from independently published providers.
Ankh CLI users configuring, inspecting, and serving MCP integrations.
useCases: Register a provider tool catalog in a central runtime.
Serve approved tools over standard MCP transport.
Inspect or diagnose available MCP integrations from the CLI.

architecture.role: Provider-neutral host with discovery, registry, policy, and transport features separated from provider adapters.
invariants: Provider-specific integrations enter only through published boundaries.
Tool execution preserves declared approval, risk, scope, and account constraints.

security: Account-scoped tools must retain explicit account identity and approval checks before execution.
